title: Buses replace trains between Babylon and Montauk
description:
Check bus departure times on TrainTime or at mta.info/schedules, as westbound buses leave earlier than normal train times.

Buses will run in three zones, making all stops along a section of the branch and running non-stop to/from Babylon. Local travel between stops in different zones is not possible.
Bay Shore through Patchogue
Bellport through Southampton
Bridgehampton through Montauk
The last trains to run are the 8:36pm from Babylon and the 9:07pm from Speonk. Service resumes with the 4:10am from Speonk.

What's happening?
Track maintenance

title: You must be in the last six cars to exit eastbound trains at Babylon
description:
The eastern half of both platforms are closed for replacement. Use the stairs by North Carll Ave or the elevator to reach the platforms.

Customers on Montauk Branch diesel trains with six or more cars, listen for announcements or ask a crew member to see if your car will open at Babylon.

Allow additional time to get upstairs, and check the TrainTime app for possible track changes as construction continues.
